qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Leading market position in Dutch pensions lacks pricing power: existing pension and life liabilities are fixed balance-sheet promises, while the Dutch pension reform (Wtp) accelerates fee competition across defined-contribution corporate schemes.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Capital-intensive life/pension model lacking pricing power, REJECT). Dominant Dutch life and pension insurer whose earnings are anchored in capital-intensive, rate-sensitive legacy books with zero pricing power on in-force contracts and ongoing margin compression during the Dutch pension reform transition.
qualitative.evidence: NN Group generated ~€1.9B in operating capital generation, but relies heavily on macro interest rates and legacy back-book releases. Long-term accounting ROE/ROIC fails the 12% compounder threshold. Pension reform (Wtp) brings fee scrutiny and switching risk.
